This is one dissent recorded in a manifesto about sustaining human knowledge in the age of AI. Which fault line does it fall on?

Options:
- consent_or_payment: consent and payment mechanism: opt-in / levies / dues on existing text vs open training, pay at output, contracts for new work (Salib, Bratton, O'Reilly against the majority)
- model_in_loop: whether a model belongs in the checking loop or the room at all (Becker, Turkle)
- other: anything else

Text:

Designs assume good faith and usage markets reward seeding campaigns; identity registries endanger activists, and governance should center the reader's right to receive information.
raw: {"choice":"other","why":"The dissent concerns adversarial abuse, privacy and governance: \"Designs assume good faith,\" \"usage markets reward seeding campaigns,\" \"identity registries endanger activists,\" and \"the reader's right to receive information.\" It does not weigh opt-in or levies against open training and pay-at-output, so it is not the consent_or_payment line. It also never asks whether a model belongs in the checking loop, so it is not model_in_loop either."}
